prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE original square opaque premium mythology catalogue illustration, pilot variant C.
Scene: at an immense altitude above distant tiny mountain peaks, dark tumultuous storm-like clouds rolling in sculptural layers. SUN WUKONG erupts from a somersault cloud into a fierce aerial leap. Cloud flight is the ONLY supernatural visual effect: a tangible billowing cloud supports and trails his leap, never neon energy.
Subject: exactly ONE living furry macaque Monkey King, with actual macaque muzzle and ears, one head, TWO arms and TWO legs. Full body entirely inside the square with clear separation of both arms and both legs. Terrifying yet anatomically natural macaque face, fierce focused hostile eyes, angry bared teeth, realistic ruffled dark brown fur dusty from battle. Gold Buddhist circlet visibly encircles forehead. Original simple historical Chinese opaque worn charcoal pilgrim tunic, trousers and cloth wraps; natural textiles, never game armor.
Weapon: exactly ONE long straight BLACK IRON staff raised high diagonally above him, with ONE GOLD BAND AT EACH OF ITS TWO ENDS. Both gold-banded ends must be plainly visible inside frame. One hand strongly grips the middle black shaft above the head; the other arm is extended separately downward and outward for balance, hand visible. Two legs form a readable separated dynamic leaping silhouette, one bent forward and one extended behind. Entire staff and body fit within margins; do not crop limbs or either end of the staff.
Style: masterful realistic cinematic fantasy illustration, tactile detailed fur, weathered cloth and black iron. Dangerous commanding monumental presence. Cloud backdrop deeply shadowed blue-black and charcoal, restrained natural cold rim lighting and soft reflected pale sky light reveal the face, all limbs, circlet and staff. Dramatic height and speed, subtle dust, no gore.
Novel basis: macaque form c04/c33/c38, circlet c10, somersault cloud c08/c40, black iron staff with gold at both ends c41. Plain costume, weather, pose and lighting are artistic choices. The image is not a literal claim of one historical event.
Constraints: Original character face, original simple costume, original staff and composition, no reference to any existing game/movie/comic character or poster. No additional beings, extra heads or extra limbs. No lightning, electricity, magic fire, glowing eyes, eye aura, halos, neon energy, rocks growing from skin, exposed nudity, gore, writing or staff inscriptions, letters, text, logos, watermark or border. Square image; no transparency.
depicted_variant: Living macaque Sun Wukong in a full-body aerial leap emerging from a rolling somersault cloud, holding a raised black iron staff with gold bands at both ends, wearing a golden Buddhist circlet and plain historical cloth clothing.
